newsitem.title: POLAND: PBR, BPH and BWR form fund.
newsitem.headline: PBR, BPH and BWR form fund.

text.p: Three listed Polish banks and the southern Polish province of Krakow will likely set up a regional investment fund in next year's first quarter, an official of one of the bank's said on Friday.

PBR deputy president Piotr Cyburt told Reuters that Polish Development Bank (PBR), Bank Przemyslowo-Handlowy (BPH), Bank Wspolpracy Regionalnej (BWR) and Krakow's provincial governor had signed a letter of intent to launch the project.
He said the fund would manage assets of state-owned companies now under the governor's control but gave no names of the firms.
"In the starting stage the Krakow provincial governor will transfer the property of about 10 companies to the investment fund," Cyburt said.
Cyburt said he hoped the treasury ministry in October would submit to the government a motion to launch the fund so that it could start operations in the first quarter.
He said the project would be profitable if the assets of the companies involved amounted to at least 10 million zlotys and that the investment period was seen at five to seven years.
